details.note:
The sealed owner choice closes the prior gate. Construction is ready; no Plan or further owner decision is required.

Exact packet contract: replace the free-form Markdown packet transport with a closed JSON object `FixPacketV1 = {version:1,instructions,prerequisites}`. `instructions` is a trim-nonblank string whose decoded contents remain opaque repair prose: no headings, regexes, frontmatter, or wording are machine-consumed. `prerequisites` is an array, possibly empty, of exact `{id,requirement}` objects. Both strings are trim-nonblank and preserved rather than normalized; `id` additionally matches `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`. IDs are case-sensitive and unique within the packet. `requirement` describes the predecessor decision, artifact, or state for auditor judgment. Extra keys, duplicate or malformed IDs, a bad version, blank prose, legacy Markdown, and malformed JSON fail activation before agent/model work begins. The admitted object and ID set are immutable for that invocation. There is no cross-invocation inference or automatic Plan-to-Apply carry-forward.

Exact blocker contract: preserve the authority branch byte-for-byte as `{cause:"authority_violation",evidence}`. Hard-cut the prerequisite branch to `{cause:"prerequisite_unmet",prerequisiteId,evidence}`. Objects remain exact and evidence remains trim-nonblank opaque prose. `prerequisiteId` uses the same identifier syntax and must equal one ID in the invocation's admitted packet. Declarations may be unused and one declaration may be referenced by multiple refused findings. The runtime does not infer prerequisites from instructions, evidence, repository state, or other receipts.

Combination law remains unchanged. Plan is exactly `{status:"planned",report}` or assignment-level `{status:"refused",report,remainingScope,blocker}`. Apply is exactly `{status:"completed"|"refused"|"partially_completed",report,classResults}` with the existing nonempty, unique-name, completed/refused discriminated class results and all existing commit, search-scope, exception, and status-homogeneity laws. Every plan refusal or refused apply class using `prerequisite_unmet` carries one declared `prerequisiteId`. With an empty declaration array, no plan or apply settlement containing that cause can be accepted; `authority_violation`, completed settlements, and all other existing legal combinations remain available.

Ordering is fixed. Activation loads Soul and phase, parses and validates the closed packet, freezes it, and only then exposes it to the Fixer or starts work. On each candidate, the existing singleton and TypeBox/phase/structural checks run first; packet-aware admission then checks every prerequisite reference against the frozen ID set. An undeclared reference is a correctable, nonterminating submission rejection: it emits no receipt and invokes no compliance audit. Only an admitted candidate receives a fresh audit over the exact Soul, admitted packet including typed declarations and opaque instructions, phase, transcript, and unchanged candidate. Audit revise remains nonterminating; malformed/auth/provider/transport audit failure remains infrastructure abort/nonzero. Pass returns the candidate unchanged with audit usage.

The mechanical guarantee is only declaration and reference integrity. Whether the referenced predecessor is actually absent, whether it is required by controlling authority, and whether that absence makes remaining assigned work presently unlawful remain Fixer auditor judgment. The auditor must continue rejecting retrospective method/history laundering and preserve honest completed-work treatment, but neither tests nor docs may claim deterministic semantic enforcement or causal proof from prompt prose. `authority_violation`, the two-cause vocabulary, opaque evidence/repair prose, all completed/partial laws, and the existing Fixer Soul remain unchanged.

This is a current-contract hard cut: no Markdown fallback, frontmatter parser, missing-ID compatibility branch, alias, migration adapter, or dual validator. Existing sealed docket bytes are not rewritten; old prerequisite leaves and old Markdown packets are historical only and are not accepted at current head. Coder remains unchanged. Packet composition, compatibility grouping, dispatch, sequencing, stopping, invocation budgets, and next-hop acceptance remain caller-owned. No dependency execution, graph, inference, scheduling, routing, retry, or orchestration is authorized. No package-version policy change is required by this authority.

Construction surfaces: add the package-owned packet schema/parser/types and packet-aware Fixer admission beside `src/package-contracts/fixer-output.ts`; use that single seam from `worker-role.ts`, terminating/public exports, and Recorder's current Fixer leaf validation rather than adding a second guard. Recorder preserves the typed `prerequisiteId` and existing audit observation/usage in accepted receipts; it does not infer semantic truth or execute dependencies. Update `role-runtime` exports, generated `dist`, README Fixer examples/CLI help/composition and Recorder wording, package lock/lifecycle fixtures, and packed contents. Use `.json` packet examples. Soul and historical dockets receive no construction edit.

Required production reds: legacy Markdown packet; malformed/extra-key/blank/duplicate-ID packet declarations; old `prerequisite_unmet` without `prerequisiteId`; malformed and undeclared IDs in both plan refusal and apply refused/mixed leaves; empty declarations attempting that cause; and any undeclared submission reaching audit or producing a receipt. Preserve existing reds for extra blocker fields, third causes, plan/apply cross-shapes, homogeneous/mixed status errors, duplicate classes/commits, malformed commits, legacy Fixer leaves, unaudited Recorder acceptance, and infrastructure laundering.

Required greens must traverse the real TypeBox tool schema, package parser, packet-aware production validator, extension activation/submission lifecycle, and Recorder/package lifecycle: admitted packets are available before work; declared references reach exactly one fresh audit in plan refusal, apply refusal, and partial apply; zero declarations still permit authority refusal and completed apply; accepted candidates and prerequisite IDs survive unchanged into Recorder receipts with audit usage; undeclared references make zero audit calls; malformed packet activation makes zero provider/agent starts; public imports and generated Recorder artifacts agree; and `npm pack` contains the new source/generated surfaces. Semantic audit sessions may be retained only as dated observations, not deterministic regressions. Run focused and full tests, typecheck, `build:recorder`, pack verification, and diff check.
